name: cavemio-split-button
title: Split button
description: Dual-action trigger: primary action on the left, trailing chevron on the right opening an aligned dropdown menu.

cavemio.accessibility:
- No external dropdown library dependency: lightweight self-contained menu logic with full keyboard handling.
- Clicking outside or pressing Escape cleanly closes the menu.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onClick
props.description: – · Called when the primary action button is clicked.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: – · List of secondary actions shown in the dropdown menu.

props.name: loading
props.description: false · Shows a spinner inside the primary button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Disables both primary and dropdown actions.

useCases.title: Publish & deploy
useCases.description: Primary "Publish" action with dropdown options for "Schedule" or "Publish as draft".

useCases.title: Save & export
useCases.description: "Save" main action paired with "Export as PDF" or "Export as JSON".

useCases.title: Git & release
useCases.description: "Commit changes" with "Commit and push" or "Create PR" secondary options.

features.title: Dual-action trigger
features.description: Independent click handlers for the primary action and the secondary chevron trigger.

features.title: Aligned floating menu
features.description: Floating menu opens directly below the button’s right edge with thin line borders and zero fuzzy shadows.

features.title: 180° chevron rotation
features.description: Chevron smoothly rotates with organic spring easing when opened.

features.title: Keyboard accessible
features.description: Navigate open menu items with ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, and dismiss with Escape.

states.title: idle
states.description: A two-part capsule with a thin line divider; pressing either half gives the whole capsule 2%.

states.title: open
states.description: The menu grows out of the chevron, which turns over; a highlight glides between rows.

states.title: loading
states.description: The icon blurs into a spinner and the label morphs ("Publish" → "Publishing"); clicks are swallowed.
